For Try revision f3f51b662624a5d14774cf9fe3d5def6822b77ae, accessibility API failure signatures in browser_composeSigned2.js and browser_composeSigned3.js were also recorded on comm-central revision 24408f13ffa935ea5dfae4855325d8ae752cb8fd. These matches are comparison evidence when triaging the same messages. Check the current logs, whether the matching push is independent, and all other failures before assigning a verdict. The matches alone do not establish that the Try push passed or that every failure was unrelated.
